The '''secession of 400100500260026''' that occurred in [[3946 BBY]] was the successful attempt of several [[G0-T0 infrastructure planning system|G0-T0]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to become the [[Droid supremacy|dictators]] of 16 [[Planet/Legends|planets]] in the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]], creating the region known as [[400100500260026]]. [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Tol Cressa]] started an attempt to [[Liberation of 400100500260026|liberate]] the region from the droids.
